summary: Sets up a permanent registry at IANA for HTTP header field names and a provisional repository for headers that are not yet formally standardized, following the process in RFC 3864. It supplies the initial contents of both so that header names can be tracked in one place.

eli5.summary: HTTP headers are labels on web messages. This memo creates an official list of those labels, plus a scratch list for new ones, so people do not accidentally pick the same name.
